question: In Jain religion, the Svetarnbara canon consists of how many of Agamas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**45**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Svetambara canon** in Jainism consists of a total of **45 Agamas**, which are the sacred scriptures of the Jain religion.
 
• These scriptures are divided into various categories, including **11 Angas**, **12 Upangas**, **4 Cheddasutras**, **10 Prakirnakas**, **6 Chedasutras**, **2 Chulikasutras**, and **4 Mulasutras**.
 
• The Agamas are considered to be the teachings of Lord Mahavira, the 24th Tirthankara of Jainism, and were compiled by his disciples after his Nirvana (liberation).
 
• The Svetambara sect of Jainism accepts these 45 Agamas as authentic and follows them as their religious texts.
 
• These texts contain philosophical concepts, ethical guidelines, rituals, cosmology, and spiritual practices to lead a disciplined and virtuous life.
